scope: Current working-tree snapshot, including uncommitted changes; seven-commit reachable Git history credential scan

findings.title: Credentials are submitted as experiment configuration
findings.evidence: Mock W&B initialization confirmed both dummy wandb_key and swanlab_key appear in config. No real credentials or external services used.
findings.recommendation: Filter credential fields from a shared public configuration before passing it to any tracker.

findings.title: License metadata and distributed license text disagree
findings.evidence: Project metadata declares Apache-2.0; LICENSE contains MIT and sgl-project copyright. Apache-derived source exists; only MIT LICENSE is bundled in wheel.
findings.recommendation: Resolve project licensing intent and distribute applicable upstream license texts and attributions; preserve original notices and document modifications.

findings.title: Source distribution omits files required by published documentation
findings.evidence: Built source archive contains setup_environment.sh but omits uv.lock and all assets, although the setup command uses uv sync --frozen and README references assets.
findings.recommendation: Include uv.lock and referenced documentation assets in the source distribution and smoke-test the extracted archive.

verification.secret_scan_limit: Pattern scan and selected manual review, not an exhaustive secret audit
